column1: # The heavy REST goals an unattended `check-push run` leaves to the pull
# request's rest-tests from the first attempt on, when the change reaches them
# only by derivation.
# One goal per line: `<goal><TAB><direct targets>`, the targets
# repository-relative paths separated by spaces; a target ending in `/` is a
# prefix. Lines starting with `#` and empty lines are comments. The direct
# targets are the files the goal mainly tests, not every file it reads.
# A goal is left to CI only when the run is unattended, CHECK_PUSH_GOALS does
# not name it, CI runs the REST goals for the head, and the change holds
# neither the goal's entry script, nor one of its direct targets, nor this
# file. Anything that cannot be decided runs the goal locally.
# When a goal this list leaves to CI fails in CI, the pull request that fixes
# the failure adds the changed files that caused it to the goal's direct
# targets. plugins/cc-cmds/orchestrator/gate.sh and
# plugins/cc-cmds/skills/_common/stage-policy.md are never added: every heavy
# goal reads them, and gate.sh changes run test-gate sections locally anyway.
